subject: math
description: Use a ruler and protractor to draw polygons with 5, 6, 8, or 10 sides, then check side lengths and angle measures for accuracy.
learningObjectives: Draw polygons with 5, 6, 8, or 10 sides using a ruler and protractor
Follow construction steps for regular and irregular polygons
Measure sides and angles to check whether a drawing matches given conditions
Apply reasonable measurement tolerances when checking hand-drawn figures
Distinguish regular and irregular polygons using side and angle measurements
prerequisites: Identify sides and vertices of a polygon
Measure line segments with a ruler
